engineeringSkip.reason: Forecasting an individual's criminal acts from neural and biometric data has no validated scientific or biological basis — this is the 'pre-crime' premise of science fiction, not a real technology, and the ethical and legal objections are fundamental rather than engineering obstacles.

factCheck.reason: No science has ever shown that brain or behavioural data can reveal a crime a person will commit in the future — predicting individual future crimes from neural signals is a science-fiction premise (popularised by Minority Report), not an engineering technology.
